topic: Privacy page structure and technical requirements
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the implementation of a privacy policy page, specifically addressing the need for country-specific URLs (e.g., `/privacy-lv`). Initially, [me] noted that while providing content in Google Docs/MS Word is acceptable, receiving it directly in HTML/CSS format would be ideal, similar to previous frontpage usage.

[p1] suggested having someone who previously worked on the site (a Serbian colleague) handle the conversion to HTML/CSS. However, [me] declined this suggestion, stating that they had seen examples of that person's work and it did not meet their standards. Instead, [me] agreed to proceed with the current method and promised to show the output once styling transfer was complete.
decisions: The privacy page content will be implemented using a structure supporting country-specific URLs (e.g., /privacy-lv).
The conversion of source material into HTML/CSS format will be handled by [me] rather than an external developer.
action_items: [me] to continue working on transferring styles and formatting for the privacy page content.
Reviewing the final output once styling transfer is complete.
